fluff.overview: The AFFS treats its infantry as professionals rather than expendable garrison filler, drawing soldiers from single worlds or neighboring systems to build the unit cohesion that the Federated Suns considers essential to effective combined-arms operations. Mechanized hover platoons ride hovercraft that provide the fastest ground transport available to conventional infantry, capable of crossing water obstacles and covering open terrain at speeds that allow them to screen for heavier formations or exploit gaps in enemy lines. Carrying man-portable long-range missile launchers alongside their primary weapons, these platoons can engage armored targets at distances well beyond normal infantry range, providing organic fire support that reduces dependence on dedicated armor or artillery assets.
